ConnectionStrings._comment: DefaultConnection is intentionally empty here. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection' ...) or the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable in prod. See appsettings.example.json.

Ingestion._comment_ServiceAddress: Human-readable identity of the process running this ingestion Worker, recorded for run-tracking provenance. NOT consumed by any endpoint yet (that wiring lands in a later PR). Hosted deployments override this via the Ingestion__ServiceAddress environment variable.
Ingestion._comment_BatchId: Optional fixed BatchId (GUID) grouping all sources of one pass. Left empty here; the Worker generates a fresh GUID per pass when absent/invalid. An orchestrator can pin one pass's BatchId via the Ingestion__BatchId environment variable.

Cbsl._comment: CBSL Daily Price Report source — LIVE, capture-only (feat/cbsl-price-parser, 2026-07-22). The Python parser + /admin/ingest-cbsl route exist; Enabled=true runs the daily incremental pass (wholesale Pettah/Dambulla + retail Narahenpita into PriceObservations, Source='CBSL'). Enabled=false is the pause switch: Disabled watermark, a documented no-op, never a source failure.

MlService._comment_harti: HartiLookbackDays: the resume lower bound is (LastObservedDate - HartiLookbackDays) so a bulletin published late for an already-passed date is re-scanned (idempotent upsert makes the re-scan free) rather than skipped forever. Default 7. FIRST RUN: an empty watermark => full ~3000-PDF backfill, which can exceed HartiIngestTimeoutSeconds; seed once via 'python ingest_harti.py' (no HTTP timeout), then the Worker's incremental passes take over.
MlService._comment: AdminApiKey is intentionally empty here. It authenticates the Worker's POST /admin/ingest-news call to the ML service (X-API-Key header, security fix F-02) and must equal the ML service's ML_ADMIN_API_KEY env var. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'MlService:AdminApiKey' ...) or the MlService__AdminApiKey environment variable in prod.
